rule: No source was edited while tests were running. Earlier failing harness versions and command outputs are preserved in CASE-XX/attempts/01/.

corrections.cause: Examiner's initial reference injector compared a synthetic string status to integers before validating type
corrections.fix: Validate status type before redirect comparison; rerun response-boundary negative control
corrections.scope: Harness/reference defect, not evidence against a source implementation

corrections.cause: Harness expected Bash diagnostic 'integer expression expected'; installed Bash emits 'integer expected'
corrections.fix: Accept both exact diagnostic spellings; original shell behavior unchanged
corrections.scope: Expectation correction, not a changed experiment

corrections.cause: Harness referenced block 01.py but the source's first fence is a text log and Python code is block 02.py
corrections.scope: Path correction before first successful simulation

corrections.cause: Review of the first successful reference found that poll exhaustion freed tracked capacity even though remote completion would be uncertain
corrections.fix: Classify exhausted or unknown polls as uncertain; defer new submissions for reconciliation while continuing existing polls
corrections.scope: Reference hardening; prior successful reference and receipts preserved under attempts/02; original loop is unchanged
